sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable f45bb59 source clean-builds network-disabled with 2 CPUs/3GiB/256 processes; original eight packages passed validator. CTest has no registered tests.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: main.cpp:110–130 root-loads and distributes METIS partitions; mesh.cpp:134–158 handles separate TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2, not CGNS MIXED.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative face residual, HLLC/Rusanov and farfield/slip/no-slip wall paths implemented; no independent smooth-order/shock study.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: LSQ reconstruction, Barth limiter and positivity fallback present; report discloses selective steady limiter freezing; no independent smooth-order test and exact historic binaries unbound.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver.cpp:600–609 uses tangential wall shear and boundary wall state; no independent wall-gradient convergence study.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS steady and full BDF residual/limiter reevaluation implemented. solver.cpp:1032–1045 allows a residual-only stop at target+1.5 orders despite remaining force drift; Re200 historical source/binary unbound.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root-only mesh, METIS and halos; original Re20 and M015 rank-study forces close in absolute terms. M015 np8 revision differs from np1/2/4 and exact binaries remain unbound.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M2 laminar marked converged while Cd rises ~15% over final5000 steps. Other cases are finite with slow drifts; Re20 Cd2.10159 and Re200 mean Cd1.27018/St~0.1862 plausible.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: All36 accepted PDF pages reviewed; original Re200 residual omitted from curated subset but preserved in original attempt. Report inaccurately claims stable M2 forces and states lift amplitude0.282 vs measured0.568.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Modular case/mesh/partition/flux/solver/output with configurable BC; fixed 2-D four-variable state limits 3-D and EOS extension.
